name: Kinoko 3
source:
Kinoko 3 is a is a collection of 10 episodes united by the theme of strange and forbidden Chinese medicine that leads to different kinds of consequences including global ones.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《Kinoko 3》是一个由10集组成的合集，以奇怪和禁忌的中药为主题，导致了包括全球后果在内的各种后果。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
